description: Ministry of Industries - The Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Industries under the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007. It establishes legal requirements and qualifications for company secretaries, including certification processes, eligibility criteria, and regulatory compliance. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for corporate governance.
